name: Adrian Popescu
bio:
Adrian's journey into motorsport catering began somewhat unexpectedly. After years running a successful traditional Romanian restaurant in Bucharest, a chance encounter with a Cavaleiro Sports team member led to an invitation to cater for a test day. His hearty, authentic dishes were a hit, and he was soon offered a permanent role. Adrian prides himself on providing nutritious and delicious meals that keep the team energized throughout long days at the track. He believes that good food is essential for peak performance and fosters a positive team environment.

Adrian's approach is characterized by meticulous planning and a commitment to sourcing the freshest, highest-quality ingredients. He adapts his menus to suit the specific needs of the team and the demands of each race weekend. He is known for his ability to create comforting and familiar dishes, even in the most challenging environments. His dedication and attention to detail ensure that everyone is well-fed and ready to perform at their best.

physical.description: Adrian is a stocky man with a warm, welcoming smile.

quirks: Always carries a small bottle of homemade plum brandy (Țuică) for "medicinal purposes".
Insists on taste-testing every dish before it leaves the kitchen.
Humming traditional Romanian folk songs while he cooks.
